signals_info.description: Time headway to the lead vehicle.

nl_Literal_translation_en: From 2 to 10 seconds from now, the time headway to the lead vehicle shall remain greater than 2 seconds.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 2 秒到第 10 秒之间，与前车的时间车头时距应始终大于 2 秒。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the ACC observation window from the second through the tenth second, the vehicle shall continuously maintain more than 2 seconds of headway.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在第 2 秒至第 10 秒的 ACC 跟车观测窗口内，车辆与前车应持续保持大于 2 秒的时间车头时距。
